name: Git Studio
description: A graphical Git client: the commit graph of every branch with the work in progress on top, staging by file, hunk or line, diffs side by side, branches, tags, stashes and worktrees, merge, rebase, cherry-pick, revert and reset from the graph, a merge conflict tool, file history and blame, and AI that writes commit messages and explains changes. Every operation runs the git program without a shell.

commands.title: Git Studio: open a repository
commands.description: Open the repository a folder is in, in Git Studio (the last one when path is absent).

commands.title: Git Studio: the repository as data
commands.description: The repository open in Git Studio: root, branch, upstream, ahead and behind, an operation in progress, the 15 latest commits, staged, unstaged and conflicted files, stashes, and the first 30 branches (the current one first) and tags, with branchCount and tagCount for all of them. To find commits, by message, author, code or path, use endue.git-studio.log.

commands.title: Git Studio: find commits as data
commands.description: Commits of the open repository as data, newest first, from every branch, remote branch and tag: those whose message holds query (plain text, any case; mode text), whose changes add or remove it (mode code) or that touched a path holding it (mode path); the latest commits without a query. author narrows by name or email. Answers up to limit commits (50, at most 200), each with sha, subject, author and date in seconds, and more when there were more.

commands.title: Git Studio: refresh
commands.description: Read the open repository again: status, branches, the graph and stashes.

commands.title: Git Studio: fetch
commands.description: Fetch every remote of the open repository and prune what is gone.

commands.title: Git Studio: pull
commands.description: Pull the current branch from its upstream. Agents pass a strategy or default to fast-forward only, without a dialog.

commands.title: Git Studio: push
commands.description: Push the current branch to its configured upstream or the named configured remote. An agent names the remote for a new branch. Rejected agent pushes return an error.

commands.title: Git Studio: stage
commands.description: Stage files of the open repository, or every change when paths is absent.

paths.description: Paths relative to the repository's root

commands.title: Git Studio: commit
commands.description: Commit what is staged with message (without one, the composer takes the focus); all stages every change first, amend rewrites the last commit, signOff adds a Signed-off-by line.

commands.title: Git Studio: create a branch
commands.description: Create a branch named name at start (HEAD when absent) and switch to it unless checkout is false; without a name, a dialog asks.

commands.title: Git Studio: switch branch
commands.description: Switch to the branch, remote branch or tag named ref; git refuses to overwrite uncommitted changes.

commands.title: Git Studio: search commits
commands.description: Search the graph: text in messages, authors and ids, code changes that add or remove the text (mode code), or commits that touched a path (mode path).

commands.title: Git Studio: file history
commands.description: Show the commits that changed a repository-relative file in Git Studio.

commands.title: Git Studio: blame a file
commands.description: Show which commits changed each line of the named repository-relative file.

commands.title: Git Studio: show the graph
commands.description: Bring the commit graph back to the center of Git Studio.

commands.title: Git Studio: read diff
commands.description: Read a unified diff of a file or all tracked files in the working copy, the index with staged, or a commit with sha. Returns text and a truncation flag.

commands.title: Git Studio: read commit
commands.description: Read a commit's metadata, message and changed files as data.

commands.title: Git Studio: read line history
commands.description: Read the commits and first 200 lines of Git blame for the named file.

commands.title: Git Studio: read file history
commands.description: Read up to 50 commits that changed a file, following its renames.

commands.title: Git Studio: unstage
commands.description: Unstage the named files or every staged change when paths is absent.

commands.title: Git Studio: stash changes
commands.description: Stash working changes with an optional message, with untracked files by default.

commands.title: Git Studio: apply stash
commands.description: Apply the stash at index (0 by default) and keep it in the stash list.

commands.title: Git Studio: pop stash
commands.description: Apply the stash at index (0 by default) and remove it after success.

commands.title: Git Studio: drop stash
commands.description: Drop the stash in the named repository. Supply both index and sha from the state command.

commands.title: Git Studio: discard files
commands.description: Discard unstaged changes of specific files in the named repository. Untracked files are deleted.

commands.title: Git Studio: merge
commands.description: Merge the named ref into the current branch. Git can stop on a conflict.

commands.title: Git Studio: rebase
commands.description: Rebase the current branch onto the named commit or branch. Git can stop on a conflict.

commands.title: Git Studio: cherry-pick
commands.description: Apply the named commit to the current branch. Select a parent of a merge by mainline.

commands.title: Git Studio: revert
commands.description: Create a commit reversing the named commit. Select a parent of a merge by mainline.

commands.title: Git Studio: create tag
commands.description: Create a tag at a commit. A message makes it an annotated tag.

commands.title: Git Studio: rename branch
commands.description: Rename a local branch in this repository.

commands.title: Git Studio: set branch upstream
commands.description: Set a local branch to track the named remote-tracking branch.

commands.title: Git Studio: delete branch
commands.description: Delete a local branch from the named repository. Force permits deleting an unmerged branch.

commands.title: Git Studio: reset history
commands.description: Move HEAD to a commit. A mixed reset keeps working files and a soft reset keeps the index too.

commands.title: Git Studio: hard reset
commands.description: Reset HEAD, the index and working files to the full commit SHA in the named repository.

commands.title: Git Studio: continue, skip or abort
commands.description: Continue, skip or abort the named operation in progress in this repository.

commands.title: Git Studio: undo history
commands.description: Undo the latest reflog move without overwriting conflicting worktree changes.

commands.title: Git Studio: redo history
commands.description: Reapply the last Git Studio history Undo if HEAD has stayed at its target.
